name: What is the difference between ADA guidelines and local building codes for accessible doorways?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between ADA guidelines and local building codes for accessible doorways?

acceptedAnswer.text: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) guidelines are federal standards that apply to public accommodations and commercial facilities, ensuring equal access for people with disabilities. Local building codes, like those adopted in Bay Area cities, often incorporate or expand upon ADA requirements for both commercial and sometimes residential projects. While ADA sets a baseline, local codes can have additional or stricter requirements. Our team ensures your project meets all applicable local and federal standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADA guidelines are federal standards for public spaces, while local building codes in the Bay Area incorporate or expand on these for both commercial and residential projects.
